answers.traces_to: Law 7 (a failed fetch is permanent in the record, never a fresh-looking reading); Law 3 (a usage figure is a measurement with an age); CP4; Law 6 (a tool has users).
answers.what: cairn/tools/usage/ reads the account's usage with one HTTPS GET, writes ~/.cairn/usage/usage.json carrying fetched_at, and keeps a failed fetch beside the last good reading, never in its place.
